National Hispanic Heritage Month Begins with US Celebrations

National Hispanic Heritage Month commenced across the United States, marked by various celebrations. The observance honors the history and cultures of Americans with origins in Spain, Mexico, Central America, South America, and the Caribbean. Events are planned nationwide to recognize the contributions of Hispanic Americans.
